decisions.reason: Because this machine builds directly on the firm's established plant-equipment and process know-how, its strong absorptive capacity and in-house R&D give it a good chance to refine the product from early market feedback, although the recent withdrawal of several 2023 automation products raises some moderate portfolio-pruning risk.

This software is very close to the firm's existing controls, planning, service, and lifecycle-support capabilities, so the firm can readily understand customer use data and improve it commercially, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
